description: Regression fixtures added after the review of PR #2 (finding 6). H01 to H03 are the reviewer's three misses, with the wording quoted in the review comment. The comment quoted only 3 of the reviewer's 17 held-out actions, and cut H03 short at '...'. H04 to H17 are builder-written stand-ins for the other 14 (different shapes: asking, telling, naming a person, granting access, re-running, autopay, exports, adverbs). They were written AFTER the misses were known, so they are regression cases, not independent held-out evidence. The reviewer's own 14 wordings, when supplied, replace the stand-ins. No real data.
